title: Christophy 2012: pcsa of psoas major at whole (mixed, literature_compiled)

imaging.level_definition: muscle group, one side (sum over model fascicles)

quantity.name: pcsa
quantity.definition: physiological CSA = muscle volume (mass/density) / fibre length (x cos pennation if stated)

source.authors: Christophy M, Faruk Senan NA, Lotz JC, O'Reilly OM
source.sample: 0 (model; literature-compiled parameters); OpenSim lumbar spine model; muscle parameters compiled from dissection studies (one side)

how_to_simulate: Sum the PCSA of all model fascicles of the group (one side) and compare. This is a compiled reference, not an independent measurement.
protocol.notes: Literature-compiled: do not pool with the original sources (kept in a separate __compiled combine group). Table 2 also lists other studies: Marras 2001 right male "PCSA" (QL 526, RA 905, LD 2174, IO 1026, EO 1006, Psoas 1949, ES 2595 mm2) - EO 1006 disagrees with Marras 2001 Table 3 (10.60 cm2 = 1060 mm2), probably a transcription error in Christophy; Delp 2001 (QL 120 = distal part only, RA 260, ES 1000 = LT 590 + IL 410, i.e. without spinalis). Per-fascicle Table 1 (238 fascicles) not extracted (multi-format rows).

data.traced_to: Bogduk, Pearcy & Hadfield 1992 [B-Ps] (sum of the 11 fascicle PCSAs in Bogduk 1992 Table 1 = 14.63 cm2 - matches)

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 re-read; RA/EO/IO values traced to Stokes 1999 and confirmed equal.
